description: Mechanical keyboard sounds with a native Windows tray menu.
pre_install: if ($global) { throw 'Klicky supports per-user installation only. Omit --global.' }
pre_uninstall: if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'Cannot determine Klicky startup state; removal stopped.' }
if ($LASTEXITCODE -or $prepared -notmatch '^KLICKY_UPDATE_V1 [01] [01]$') { throw 'Cannot stop the owned Klicky bundle; removal stopped.' }
@{ startup = $startup; restart = ($fields[1] -eq '1'); paused = ($fields[2] -eq '1') } | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content -LiteralPath $receipt -Encoding UTF8
if ($LASTEXITCODE -or $removed -notmatch '^KLICKY_STARTUP_V1 (ABSENT|FOREIGN)$') { throw 'Cannot verify startup cleanup; removal stopped.' }
post_install: if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'Could not restore Klicky login startup; update receipt retained.' }
if ($state.paused -eq $true) { & "$dir/klicky.exe" service start --paused } else { & "$dir/klicky.exe" service start }
if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'Could not restart Klicky; update receipt retained.' }
notes: Open Klicky from Start, or run: klicky service start
Optional login startup: klicky service enable
Before updating: klicky service stop; then scoop update klicky; then klicky service start.
Settings and custom packs stay in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Klicky, including with scoop uninstall --purge.
Use one installation method. See the bucket README for migration and removal details.
